ownerWords: Maybe sevens - better; the editorial archetype suits this design language so it is not pulled down as much. Colors could be better for an editorial. The graphs in weir-plates were good, and almanac-rail's full-record graph was a genuinely good way to express the numbers - real visual differentiation. Defect: em dashes present in all arms - not supposed to be there. Structure: open with an executive brief of the finding, then the detail. Fine overall, not the greatest.
